content: Gǝlghantgǝlǝg Yesu Kǝ Uudah Alfu Uufaɗa
Makwahiin kǝ sarta, kaa gwiya faɗǝgǝtfaɗǝg kǝ uudah ba ɗyaka. Maay tsau nǝ dǝgzǝg vakatǝr biya, kaa ɗahgantɗahǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ mbǝrzahaan amaa taa kǝ iitǝra,
“Ən ɓa zhuwadaala uudahaana, hǝnga hǝkǝrɗ wan kwan ar ba vakar bakwal dǝgzǝga.
Akwama ɗiiyantǝrǝsɗiiga daas da hǝnnyaha dǝ waiya, ar da mbasda biya. Aɗaba kyalǝm saral vaka bǝtkya.”
Am mbǝrzahaana, “Da tlǝvkǝna mǝr nǝ dǝga zǝg makwanǝn kǝ tǝghal kwada tlǝgaara kǝ uudahaani?”
Kaa ndavatǝrundavǝg kǝ Yesu taakiya, “Bruudi ngwen wa vakaruwi?” Aiyam nǝ iitǝra, “Uuɗifa.”
Kaa tagtǝrtag kǝ iin kǝ uudah aa cahwararacahwarǝg tǝ haiya. Kǝsant kǝ iin kǝ bruudiin uuɗifna, kaa tagar uus kǝ Daadamazhigǝla, lahnana, vǝltǝr kǝ mbǝrzahaan kiyava tagwar kǝ uudaha.
Mǝng dlaɓ kilf mishish hǝɗiikǝn vakaatǝra. Faraa kǝ iin kǝ barka, amaa tagwamtǝrnatagw kǝ uudaha
Zaruuzǝg nǝ uudaha, tlatǝrtlǝga, ar dzahant nǝ mbǝrzahaan kǝ tǝmgaan alghw uuɗifa.
Lii zaruuzǝg ar mǝng damma alfu uufaɗa. Kaa ɗiitǝrǝs kǝ iin dagal kǝ uudaha.
Bat watsǝr kaa dǝgǝmdǝg kǝ iin damma pɛrrayu dǝ mbǝzahaan, ngal dagal kǝ iin damma larda Dalmanuta.
Gata Dǝga Sǝrga
Kaa sagau kǝ Farisiyah sa ɓalagajau dǝ Yesu, Sarsaa fǝshgaana, kaa ghalgaan kǝ iitǝr maa martǝrda kǝ dǝga jappǝr kwada nǝg kǝ dǝga sǝrg saay ma ghǝrazhigǝla.
Kaa dǝya shifǝg kǝ iin bad ndzǝɗɗa, amaa, “Aujilbǝg kǝskuram uudaha zaman am gata dǝga sǝrgi? Ən tagkurtag kǝ jiira, maay watlǝrǝn kǝ dǝga sǝrǝgi da marvǝtǝr kǝ uudaha zamanǝn biya.”
Tǝhalakwaha kaa ɗuutǝrǝsɗuug kǝ iina, kaa daas kǝ iin damma perrayuwa, kaa dzǝva dagal kǝ iin dat ghyaba kwaha.
Yista Farisiyaha Ard Hirudus
Viyatǝraavig kǝsa bruudi kǝ mbǝrzaha Yesu, ba pal wa vakatǝr ma pɛrrayuwa.
Kaa ɓǝlaatǝraɓǝlǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ maggiya, amaa, “Famfǝg kǝ hyǝmmi dǝgiya, dlaɓa am fǝgaan kǝ taaɗ tǝ yista Farisiyaha ar dǝ dǝga Hirudus.”
Kaa tagkǝvaatag kǝ mbǝrzah ma taatakaatǝr taakiya, “Mbakyarvad kiyam maay dǝ bruudi ha waa taag nǝ iin ndǝkwahini?”
Nǝghaakaba nǝ iin kǝ dǝgiti ar taag nǝ iitǝra, kaa ndavtrundavǝg kǝ iina, “Aujibǝg am taakiya am maay dǝ bruudi? Mbats, gwastǝn nǝghamaaka biya? Dlaɓa sǝramaaka biya? Mbats dǝkdǝk ghǝraruwa?
Am dǝ gyiyaha, am nǝghǝga biya? Am dǝ hyǝmmiyaha, am cinnga biya? Mbats dzamamna biya?
Ma sartakwa lahantǝru nai kǝ bruudi dlǝɓ kǝ uudah alfu dlǝɓna, alghw ngwen wa dzahamant nǝ uuram kǝ tǝmngaani?” Kaa ngugangug kǝ iitǝr taakiya, “Alghw kǝlawa tar buwa.”
“Bruudi uuɗifǝn kwa lahantǝru nai kǝ uudahna, maandala alghwah ngwen wa dzahamant nǝ uuram righarighan dǝ ghwadgahaanii?” Am nǝ iitǝr taa kǝ iina, “Alghw uuɗiffa.”
Aiyam Yesu taa kǝ iitǝra, “Gwaastǝn nǝghamaaka bi kǝ ǝlbǝgar biya?”
Mbǝghanambǝg Yesu Kǝ Gulf ma Betsaida
Daragha ba nǝ iitǝr damma Betsaida, kaa sǝvardasǝg nǝ uudan gulf kǝ Yesu, kaa ghalgaan kǝ iitǝr maa tapna kǝ gulfiina.
Viyiit kǝ iin kǝ dǝva gulfǝna, taɗda kǝ iin dagal da gyilga kǝssa. Tǝfgharvaba nǝ iin kǝ ashavai kǝ uudanǝn magyiya, tapna kǝ iina. Ndavaru kǝ iin taakiya, “Agha nǝghǝganǝghǝg kǝ dǝgita?”
Kaa dzǝgantdzǝg kǝ gulfǝn kǝ ghǝran damma zhigǝl, amaa, “ǝn nǝghǝganǝghǝg kǝ uudaha, ǝn nǝghtǝr band uufaha, ar gwayaiva.”
Kaa gwiya tapgaan kǝ Yesu kǝ gyiyaana. Ngal wurgǝtwurǝg nǝ gyi tǝvakaiya, mbana, kaa nǝghǝganǝghǝg kǝ dǝgit ba marauwa.
Kaa ɓǝlgarsɓǝlǝg Yesu daas da hǝnyaha, amaa taa kǝ iina, “Gwiya tǝbi kǝ zǝrkǝss biya.”
Haighanthaig Bitrus Taakiya Yesu iin nǝ Kǝristi
Yesu ard mbǝrzahaan daral damma zǝrkǝssah ma Kaisariya Filibi. Tǝghǝrdǝga kaa ndavtǝrundavǝg kǝ iin kǝ mbǝrzahaan taakiya, “Ən war nai ma tag nǝ uudahi?”
Kaa ngugangug kǝ iitǝr taakiya, “Kyallǝm ar taaki, agha Yuhwan dadda tsuufǝga, kyallǝm ar taakiya, agha Iliya tlayanga, kyallǝm dlaɓ ar taakiya, agha pal ma tlayangaha.”
Kaa ndavtǝruundavǝg kǝ iina, “Kuramǝm, ǝn warnai mam tlǝg nǝ uurami?” Ngwaangug nǝ Bitrus taakiya, “Kǝgh nǝ Kǝristi.”
Kaa ɓǝltǝra kǝ maggi kǝ mbǝrzahaan aa tagararbi aanji ndǝwar kǝ ǝlbǝg tǝghǝr kǝ iin biya.
Tagadatag Yesu Tǝghǝr Kǝ ǝmtsǝgaana

Makwanǝn kǝ sarta, kaa fǝgarzhafǝg kǝ Yesu tsagtǝr dǝgit tǝghǝr kǝ ɗuuli da hǝɓǝg Zǝra Uud kǝ dlaɗ shah-shaha. Ar da naabi nǝ maalah tǝghǝr kǝ dlamaa kǝlawa ard maalaha zhiila kǝssa uufah, ard lii tsaga adzahadzaha Muusa, da tsǝvaana, tǝhala hǝng hǝkǝrɗ da ciig dǝ shiifǝgga.
Taggada bat ɓalaɓal kǝ kwanǝn kǝ ǝlɓǝga. Kaa ɗahanat nǝ Bitrus kǝ Yesu damma dlǝmmbaava, buuraraana.
Kaa gwivǝt kǝ yesu vazǝna kǝ mbǝrzahaana, ngal caa gyi kǝ iin tǝ Bitrus taakiya, “Yagh vakar, shatanahna! Dzamaghǝragha band uuda duniya, band dzamaghǝra Daadamazhigǝl biya.”
Tǝhalakwaha ɗahant kǝ iin kǝ uudah ar dǝ mbǝrzahaan ba hǝrz dǝ iina, amaa taa kǝ iitǝra, “Baɗǝm daddakwa naa gata kaiya, ɗuwant kǝghǝraana, kǝssant kǝ tlaɓa hǝrtǝgaan kaa gatǝkwagatǝgga.
Baɗǝm daddakwa naa fa shifǝggaana, da tlǝkǝna biya. Dlaɓa baɗǝm daddakwa ɓǝlda shifǝggaan mbakyarvad kaiya, ar dǝ ǝlbǝga marawa, aafǝga ba dǝ fǝga.
Au payɗaan akwama tlakkǝnatlǝg nǝ uudan kǝ dǝga duni ba ɗǝm ɓǝlda kǝ shifǝggaani?
Dlaɓ au wada vǝlda nǝ uudan dlakulva shifǝggaani?

Baɗǝm daddakwa cinnga zhirwara ard dǝ ǝlbǝgar ma kwanǝn kǝ zamana kwa maay jiir mavakai biya dlaɓa dǝ haipah ba ɗyaka, Zara Uud ndakwi da cinngaan kǝ zhǝruwan ma sartǝn da saggau nǝ iin ma ndangǝra Daddaana ǝmtaɗ dǝ zǝrɓǝlgah kwar caccuwanacaccuwana.”
